title: fix(components,plugin-detail,app-shell,fields): a date-only value renders the day it names west of UTC at four more sites (objectui#10183)
body:
Fixes #10183

Clause-②: yes — `@object-ui/core` gains one export, `toDisplayDate`. No other published face moves: nothing is removed, renamed or retyped, and `@object-ui/fields` does not re-export it.

## What was wrong (measured before editing, `origin/main` `a78cd37`)

The objectui#10110 repair put the date-only rule into the shared parse step (`toDisplayDate`, in `@object-ui/core`'s `utils/date-display.ts`). Four sites never went through that step. Each site was probed in a forked vitest with the zone switched in-process, in `America/Los_Angeles` and in `UTC`. A fixed instant `2026-08-01T03:00:00.000Z` read hour 20 in LA and hour 3 in UTC, which confirms the zone really moved.

| site | LA | UTC |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `data-table` default cell, `2026-08-01` (en) | `Jul 31` | `Aug 1` |
| `RelatedList` with no child schema, which falls back to that cell, `2026-09-01` | `Aug 31` | `Sep 1` |
| summary chip `date`, `2026-08-01`, zh-CN | `2026年7月31日` | `2026年8月1日` |
| History `date`, `2026-08-01`, en-US | `7/31/2026` | `8/1/2026` |
| `date` cell, due-type `2026-09-03` on clock `2026-09-03T10:35Z` | `Today`, red | `Today`, not red |

A1 held at every site. All four share one mechanism: a date-only string is parsed as UTC midnight and then read in local time. They also share one repair: take the `Date` from the shared step.

## The route

- **`data-table`** (`formatCellValue`) passes the STRING to `formatDate` / `formatDateTime`. Before, it built a `Date` from `Date.parse`, and the shared step leaves a `Date` untouched. `Date.parse` is still called, but only as a validity check: an unparsable string still renders as itself. No export was needed here, and this change also covers the `RelatedList` path.
- **Summary chip, History (`auditHistoryDisplay`), `DateCellRenderer`'s overdue predicate** take their `Date` from `toDisplayDate`. The export was necessary (A2 held). None of the already-exported functions produces the chip's `dateStyle: 'medium'` face. `summaryChip.displayLocale-9453.test.tsx`'s `EN_CONTROL_ROWS` pin that face, and `formatDate` would drop the current year. The overdue comparison needs a `Date`, not a string. The faces are unchanged.
- **Rejected route (A3): a local re-parse at each site.** I did not take it. Each site calls the one shared step.
- The comment above the overdue computation is corrected. `new Date(safe)` accepts exactly what `formatDate` accepts, but it does not reproduce the day `formatDate` renders. It now answers validity and the `title` only.
- `toDisplayDate`'s doc comment says why it is exported. It also warns that the result is to be read with local getters only: for a date-only value its `toISOString()` names the previous day east of UTC. That is also why the date cell's hover `title` still comes from the raw parse.

⚠️ **Declared behaviour change beyond the `date` branches.** The chip and History each have one parse shared by their `date` and `datetime` arms. The `datetime` arm therefore now follows the shared path's rule that the value's shape decides. An instant still converts into the viewer's zone. A date-only value stored on a `datetime` field now reads as local midnight of its day, exactly as `formatDateTime` already renders it. Before, it read as the previous evening west of UTC and as a morning hour east of it. This is pinned (History) and stated in the changeset.

## The zone pins, and why they are shaped this way

A4 held, with one refinement that I measured. Writing `process.env.TZ` in a test body does not move the zone on the default `threads` pool. The same assignment in the same file **does** move it on `--pool=forks`: a forked worker is a real process main thread, where Node's `TZ` setter resets the zone. Probe readings: `after: America/Los_Angeles, hour 20` on forks, and `after: UTC, hour 3` on threads with `process.env.TZ` reading LA. The zone also cannot be handed to a child vitest through its environment, because the root config re-pins UTC at load (that is what `vitest-timezone-pin-8366.test.ts` proves).

So:

- Each site has a pin beside it. Every case is skipped in the normal run. When driven, each case sets its zone per case, and each zone opens with a rig case: `Intl`'s resolved zone plus the local hour of the fixed instant. The pins are `data-table.dateOnlyZone-10183`, `summaryChip.dateOnlyZone-10183` (chip plus the `RelatedList` path), `auditHistoryDisplay.dateOnlyZone-10183` and `dateCell.overdueZone-10183`.
- `scripts/__tests__/date-only-zone-pins-10183.test.ts` drives all four with **one** spawned vitest. It uses `--pool=forks`, `OBJECTUI_DATE_ZONE_CHILD=1` and a JSON report. It fails unless each pin file was collected, ran at least one case, and every case passed. A skipped case counts as a failure, so a child that stopped honouring the flag cannot pass by staying silent.
- Controls: `Asia/Shanghai` in every pin, which catches an hour-offset "repair"; instants that must keep converting; yesterday's deadline, which must stay red.
- Why a driver rather than self-spawning files: the self-spawning shape failed type-check where the pins live. The `@object-ui/components` test program makes `NODE_ENV` required on `ProcessEnv` (its `global.d.ts`), so `childVitestEnv` does not compile there. The `@object-ui/fields` test program loads no Node types at all. The spawn therefore lives in `scripts/__tests__`, which has both, and `spawned-vitest-child-env-8616` still sees it using the helper.
- `date-display.dateOnlyZone-10110.test.ts` gains two readings of the exported step: local midnight of the named day in all zones, and an instant left untouched. `data-table-date-convention-7620.test.tsx`'s `shared` helper now spells the call the cell makes.

## Ablation (one-shot; committed head `87fb0e5ae`; via `ablation-replace.mjs`, each leg's anchor 1 to 0 on disk, restore proven blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty)

Each leg puts one site's line back to its `origin/main` spelling and runs the driver:

| leg | red in the child | stayed green |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `formatDate(value, …)` back to `formatDate(new Date(ts), …)` | data-table west `Jul 31`; RelatedList west `Aug 31` | rigs, east controls, instants, chip, audit, date cell |
| chip `toDisplayDate(val)` back to `new Date(val)` | chip west `2026年7月31日` | everything else |
| audit `toDisplayDate(value …)` back to `new Date(value …)` | `date` west `7/31/2026`; the declared `datetime` date-only rows, west `Jul 31, 2026, 5:00 PM` and east | instants, rigs |
| overdue `toDisplayDate(safe …)` back to `date` | today west `{ text: 'Today', red: true }` | yesterday red, east, rigs |

The direction was as predicted: each leg turned only its own site's cases red.

## Verification

After merging `origin/main` (`c9e073ac8`), HEAD is `3d3ffed3b`. The merge was clean. The only file of mine that main touched is `packages/fields/src/index.tsx`, and main's change there is in `NumberCellRenderer`.

- On `3d3ffed3b`: the driver, `spawned-vitest-child-env-8616`, the 10110 and 7620 pins, `auditHistoryDisplay.test`, `DateCellRenderer.test`, `dateCell.unparsableValue-8581`, `datetimeCell.dueLikeAffordance-8958`, `summaryChip.displayLocale-9453` and `NumberScaleOutOfRange-10071`: `Test Files 10 passed (10)`, `Tests 132 passed (132)`. `@object-ui/fields` type-check exit 0.
- On `3d3ffed3b`, lint: `eslint` over the 12 changed `.ts`/`.tsx` files gave 0 errors. The config's lint population is `files: ['**/*.{ts,tsx}']`, and eslint's JSON output counted 12 files. Type-aware linting is off (no `parserOptions.project` / `projectService` in `eslint.config.js`), so this diff cannot change a verdict on any untouched file. Each modified file has the same warning count at base and at head. The two new pin files carry one `no-explicit-any` warning each, the same `as any` shape their siblings use.
- On `3d3ffed3b`, gates exit 0: `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check-changeset-fixed`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:new-line-citations`, `check:control-bytes`, `check:phantom-deps`, `type-check:coverage`, `lint:coverage`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, and the report-only `check:changeset-claims`. That last one names 17 pending bodies for the touched files; I read the ones that mention these call sites, and none is falsified.
- On `87fb0e5ae` (pre-merge), full suites: `packages/core` plus `packages/fields` gave 339 files passed and 1 skipped (my pin). `packages/components`, in 2 shards, gave 144 plus 142 passed and 1 skipped. `packages/plugin-detail`, in 2 shards, gave 98 plus 98 passed and 1 skipped. type-check was exit 0 for all five packages and for `type-check:scripts`, run after building the dependency closure.

NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI:
- The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite. Per the dispatching seat, locally I ran only `auditHistoryDisplay.test.ts` and the pin: `auditHistoryDisplay.ts`'s one importer, `RecordDetailView`, is reached by no test that feeds `sys_audit_log` rows.
- `check:readme-exports`: no README changed.

## Acceptance notes (observations, not filed)

- `DateTimeCellRenderer` passes a pre-parsed `Date` onward, the same shape as the `data-table` one. A date-only value on a `datetime` cell would therefore read the previous evening west of UTC. Not probed, and I found no producer that sends one. It is outside this claim's regions.
- `validation-engine`'s `date_min` / `date_max` default message formats `new Date(params)`. A date-only bound would name the previous day west of UTC. Not probed.
- A `date` field whose stored value arrives datetime-shaped (`2026-08-06T00:00:00.000Z`, the shape `auditHistoryDisplay.test.ts` uses) still reads the previous day west of UTC. That is the shared path's own value-shape rule. If it matters, it belongs to the producer.

## Overlap with in-flight work

objectui#10227 edited `NumberCellRenderer` in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` and has already landed on main. It merged into this branch cleanly. Draft objectui#8941 edits an icon spelling in `DetailView.tsx`, well away from the summary-chip region this PR changes.
